FAITH
The Cult of Ulric
has it's centre at
Middenheim. Many
Ulricans wear symbols
depicting wolf heads or
the Eternal Flame.
STRIFE
Not all Ulricans heed the
word of Ar-Ulric. The Sons
of Ulric believe themselves
blood descendants of the god.
They are fanatics who insist
that one of them should be
made the High Priest.
CHEER
The Cup of Cheer is a
beloved icon of Middenheimer
hospitality. Each year it is
awarded to a venue in the
city with a reputation for
friendly welcomes and a lively
atmosphere.
